description: Shared services for the mods of the kit. It makes the git worktrees of Issues, PRs, Spec Board and the Git panel: 1 folder for all of them, and 1 setup (files to copy, commands to run) for each new one.

settings.label: Worktree folder
settings.hint: Every new worktree goes to <folder>/<repository>/<branch>. Empty: ~/.herdr/worktrees, the folder of Herdr's own worktrees (the Herdr sidebar then shows the space under its repository). On another machine, only a value that starts with ~ applies.

settings.label: Files for every worktree
settings.hint: Every file in this folder goes into each new worktree of this computer, with the same relative path. A file that exists in the worktree stays.

settings.label: Setup commands
settings.hint: Commands that run in every new worktree (for example npx to install plugins), before the commands of the repository.
